Coverage & methodology

Why isn't my school here?

A great music school can be absent from the calendar for several reasons. We need enough information to help you tune into a particular free concert, and our coverage is still growing.

What earns a place in the calendar

  1. An official source: a school, its music department, or its designated concert presenter confirms the broadcast.
  2. A dated performance: the concert has a clear start time and time zone within the next 45 days.
  3. A public, free way to watch: a player, event link, or clearly identified channel. A free account is acceptable when anyone can register; a school-only password or paid stream is not.

We focus on concerts and music performances from conservatories and universities, with some music masterclasses and related performances. Replays, admissions sessions, graduation ceremonies, and research talks don't establish an upcoming concert stream. Free admission to a hall doesn't establish free online access either.

A school's reputation or ranking doesn't determine inclusion. Some schools publish only their next broadcast; others announce a whole season. A school can be included but have no upcoming streams right now. We can't promise continuous, around-the-clock coverage.

How the listings stay current

The calendar is updated daily from official school schedules. Each listing links to the school's event page for program details and any changes.

Concert times are converted to your time zone. When no end time is supplied, calendar downloads reserve an estimated 90 minutes. Check the linked official event before watching, especially if you saved it earlier.

Why a school might be missing

  • It hasn't announced an upcoming public livestream yet, or only streams selected performances.
  • Its streams require payment, a school-only login, or a private password.
  • Its calendar lists concerts in the hall, but doesn't confirm which will be available online.
  • We can find recordings, but can't yet verify a future broadcast's date, time, or viewing link.
  • We haven't added the school yet, or we're still working out how to keep its listings reliable.

A missing school isn't a judgment on its quality, and it doesn't mean it never streams. This is a growing project, and there are plenty of good additions still to discover.

Looking for professional orchestras or opera?

Bachtrack's livestream listings cover professional orchestras, opera, and other performances beyond our school-focused calendar. The listings are free to browse, but individual streams may be free, pay-to-view, or require a subscription. Look for “Free to view” and check the provider's viewing conditions.

Have a school in mind?

Contact me and let me know which school you’d love to see here. If you have a concert or livestream link, send that along too. I’ll take a look and see whether I can make it happen!
